label: News Analyst
description: Fetches cryptocurrency news from multiple RSS feeds including CoinDesk, CoinTelegraph, Decrypt, The Block, and more.

tools.name: get_crypto_news
tools.description: Fetch recent news articles for a cryptocurrency from multiple RSS sources. Returns titles, URLs, sources, and publication dates.

label: Chart Analyst
description: Fetches trading chart images and returns them for Claude to perform technical analysis.

tools.name: analyze_chart
tools.description: Fetch a trading chart image by URL and return it for technical analysis. Claude identifies trend direction, support/resistance levels, chart patterns, and indicator readings.

label: Contractor
description: Allows agents to consult hired contractor models (e.g. Grok, GPT-4o via OpenRouter). Checks for an active contract agreement before calling the external model.

tools.name: ask_contractor
tools.description: Send a prompt to a hired contractor model and get their response. Validates the contract is active before calling.

tools.name: list_contractors
tools.description: List all registered contractors and their contract status.

label: Orchestrator
description: Team orchestration tools for lead agents. Provides run_team and ask_reporter to invoke direct reports and collect their results without any hardcoded HTTP or polling logic in SKILL.md.

tools.name: run_team
tools.description: Invoke all direct reports in parallel and wait for their results.

tools.name: ask_reporter
tools.description: Invoke a single direct report by name and wait for their result.

tools.name: get_my_decisions
tools.description: Fetch your own recent decisions. Use before making a new decision to review what you decided previously.

label: Wallet
description: Gives agents access to their Solana wallet and enables automatic x402 payments. Use wallet_fetch instead of regular HTTP when calling APIs that may charge per request.

tools.name: wallet_address
tools.description: Get this agent's Solana wallet address.

tools.name: wallet_fetch
tools.description: Make an HTTP request with automatic x402 payment. If the API returns 402 Payment Required, payment is made automatically from the agent's wallet and the request is retried.

label: Crypto OHLCV
description: Fetches OHLCV candlestick data from crypto exchanges (Binance, Bybit). Agents use this for technical analysis calculations.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Fetch OHLCV candlestick data for a trading pair. Returns candles with open, high, low, close, volume, and timestamp for technical indicator calculations.

tools.name: get_indicators
tools.description: Calculate technical indicators (EMA, SMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR, VWAP) for a trading pair. Returns latest values, computed server-side.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Search for available trading pairs on an exchange.

label: Crypto Data
description: Fetches derivatives market data from Binance Futures. Funding rates, open interest, long/short ratios, top trader positions, and taker buy/sell volume.

tools.name: get_funding_rate
tools.description: Get the current funding rate, mark price, index price, and next funding time for a futures pair.

tools.name: get_open_interest
tools.description: Get current open interest with 1h, 4h, and 24h change percentages for a futures pair.

tools.name: get_long_short_ratio
tools.description: Get the global long/short account ratio showing percentage of accounts long vs short.

tools.name: get_top_trader_positions
tools.description: Get the long/short position ratio of the top 20% of traders by margin balance.

tools.name: get_taker_buy_sell_volume
tools.description: Get taker buy vs sell volume ratio showing aggressive buyer/seller pressure.

label: Control Tower
description: Admin tools for the Control Tower agent. Lists agents, invokes runs, and inspects run results across the entire muxAI deployment. Excluded from every other agent.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List every agent in this muxAI deployment (excluding the Control Tower itself).

tools.name: invoke_agent
tools.description: Invoke a specific agent by name, role, or id and wait for the run to complete.

tools.name: get_run_status
tools.description: Fetch the status, result, and logs of a single run by id.

tools.name: get_agent_decisions
tools.description: Fetch an agent's recent decisions and user-marked outcomes.

tools.name: stop_agent
tools.description: Kill the active run for an agent.

tools.name: pause_agent
tools.description: Pause an agent so the scheduler skips it until resumed.

tools.name: resume_agent
tools.description: Resume a paused or errored agent back to idle.

tools.name: reset_agent_memory
tools.description: Clear the shared Claude session for an agent with Active Memory.

label: Events
description: Calendar of upcoming and recent events that may impact trading. Macro events (FOMC, CPI, NFP, ECB), options expiries (BTC/ETH on Deribit), and recent hacks. Reads from the local events database populated by the events-collector scheduler.

tools.name: get_upcoming_events
tools.description: Get upcoming calendar events (macro, options expiries, asset-specific) sorted by start time. Use BEFORE making a trade decision to avoid entering ahead of high-impact news.

tools.name: get_recent_events
tools.description: Get events that already happened in the past N hours (e.g. recent hacks). Useful for retrospective analysis.

label: Docs
description: Search and read muxai platform documentation. Agents can look up trade decision formats, orchestration behavior, SKILL.md conventions, and more.

tools.name: search_mux_ai
tools.description: Search the muxai documentation. Returns matching pages with titles, paths, and snippets.

tools.name: get_page_mux_ai
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a documentation page by its path.

label: TradingView Desktop
description: Read and control the locally-running TradingView Desktop app via Chrome DevTools Protocol on port 9222. Provides 78 tools: chart navigation, OHLCV and indicator reads, Pine indicator output (lines/labels/tables/boxes), screenshots, drawings, alerts, replay mode, watchlist/tabs/panes, and Pine Script development. Requires TradingView Desktop running with --remote-debugging-port=9222 on the same host as muxAI. Call chart_get_state first to discover loaded indicators and entity IDs; always pass summary=true on data_get_ohlcv; always pass study_filter on data_get_pine_* tools.

tools.name: tv_health_check
tools.description: Check CDP connection to TradingView and return current chart state.

tools.name: tv_discover
tools.description: Report which known TradingView API paths are available and their methods.

tools.name: tv_ui_state
tools.description: Get current UI state: which panels are open, what buttons are visible/enabled/disabled.

tools.name: tv_launch
tools.description: Launch TradingView Desktop with Chrome DevTools Protocol enabled. Auto-detects install on Mac/Windows/Linux.

tools.name: chart_get_state
tools.description: Get current chart state (symbol, timeframe, chart type, indicators, entity IDs). Call this first.

tools.name: chart_set_symbol
tools.description: Change the chart symbol (e.g. BTCUSD, AAPL, OANDA:XAUUSD, NYMEX:CL1!).

tools.name: chart_set_timeframe
tools.description: Change the chart timeframe/resolution (e.g. 1, 5, 15, 60, D, W, M).

tools.name: chart_set_type
tools.description: Change chart type: Bars(0), Candles(1), Line(2), Area(3), Renko(4), Kagi(5), PointAndFigure(6), LineBreak(7), HeikinAshi(8), HollowCandles(9). Pass name or number.

tools.name: chart_manage_indicator
tools.description: Add or remove an indicator/study. USE FULL NAMES: 'Relative Strength Index', 'MACD', 'Bollinger Bands' — short names like RSI/EMA do NOT work.

tools.name: chart_get_visible_range
tools.description: Get the visible date range (unix timestamps) and bars range on the chart.

tools.name: chart_set_visible_range
tools.description: Zoom the chart to a specific date range (unix timestamps).

tools.name: chart_scroll_to_date
tools.description: Jump the chart view to center on a specific date (ISO format or unix timestamp string).

tools.name: symbol_info
tools.description: Get detailed metadata about the current symbol (name, exchange, type, description).

tools.name: symbol_search
tools.description: Search for symbols by name or keyword, optionally filtered by type (stock/futures/crypto/forex).

tools.name: data_get_ohlcv
tools.description: Get OHLCV bar data from the chart. ALWAYS pass summary=true unless you need individual bars (saves context).

tools.name: data_get_indicator
tools.description: Get indicator/study info and input values by entity ID.

tools.name: data_get_strategy_results
tools.description: Get strategy performance metrics from Strategy Tester.

tools.name: data_get_trades
tools.description: Get trade list from Strategy Tester (optional max_trades).

tools.name: data_get_equity
tools.description: Get equity curve data from Strategy Tester.

tools.name: quote_get
tools.description: Get real-time quote data (price, OHLC, volume). Default = current chart symbol.

tools.name: depth_get
tools.description: Get order book / DOM data from the chart. Requires DOM panel open in TradingView.

tools.name: data_get_pine_lines
tools.description: Read horizontal price levels drawn by Pine Script indicators (line.new). Deduplicated, sorted. Pass study_filter to target a specific indicator.

tools.name: data_get_pine_labels
tools.description: Read text labels drawn by Pine Script indicators (label.new). Returns text and price pairs. Pass study_filter.

tools.name: data_get_pine_tables
tools.description: Read table data drawn by Pine Script indicators (table.new). Returns formatted text rows per table. Pass study_filter.

tools.name: data_get_pine_boxes
tools.description: Read box/zone boundaries drawn by Pine Script indicators (box.new). Deduplicated {high, low} zones. Pass study_filter.

tools.name: data_get_study_values
tools.description: Get current numeric values from ALL visible indicators (RSI, MACD, BB, EMAs, custom plot() outputs).

tools.name: pine_get_source
tools.description: Get current Pine Script source code from the editor. WARNING: can return 200KB+ for complex scripts.

tools.name: pine_set_source
tools.description: Inject Pine Script source code into the editor.

tools.name: pine_compile
tools.description: Compile / add the current Pine Script to the chart.

tools.name: pine_smart_compile
tools.description: Intelligent compile: detects button, compiles, checks errors, reports study changes.

tools.name: pine_get_errors
tools.description: Get Pine Script compilation errors from Monaco markers.

tools.name: pine_get_console
tools.description: Read Pine Script console/log output (compile messages, log.info(), errors).

tools.name: pine_save
tools.description: Save the current Pine Script (Ctrl+S).

tools.name: pine_new
tools.description: Create a new blank Pine Script (indicator | strategy | library).

tools.name: pine_open
tools.description: Open a saved Pine Script by name (case-insensitive match).

tools.name: pine_list_scripts
tools.description: List saved Pine Scripts.

tools.name: pine_analyze
tools.description: Static analysis on Pine source WITHOUT compiling. Catches out-of-bounds, unguarded array.first()/last(), bad loops, implicit bool casts. Offline.

tools.name: pine_check
tools.description: Compile Pine via TradingView's server API without the chart open. Returns compilation errors/warnings.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the TradingView chart. Regions: full, chart, strategy_tester.

tools.name: draw_shape
tools.description: Draw a shape on the chart: horizontal_line, vertical_line, trend_line, rectangle, text. Pass overrides JSON for styling.

tools.name: draw_list
tools.description: List all shapes/drawings on the chart.

tools.name: draw_clear
tools.description: Remove all drawings from the chart.

tools.name: draw_remove_one
tools.description: Remove a specific drawing by entity ID (from draw_list).

tools.name: draw_get_properties
tools.description: Get properties and points of a specific drawing.

tools.name: alert_create
tools.description: Create a price alert via the TradingView alert dialog (condition, price, optional message).

tools.name: alert_list
tools.description: List active alerts.

tools.name: alert_delete
tools.description: Delete all alerts or open the context menu for deletion.

tools.name: batch_run
tools.description: Run an action across multiple symbols and/or timeframes. Actions: screenshot, get_ohlcv, get_strategy_results.

tools.name: replay_start
tools.description: Start bar replay mode, optionally at a specific YYYY-MM-DD date.

tools.name: replay_step
tools.description: Advance one bar in replay mode.

tools.name: replay_autoplay
tools.description: Toggle autoplay in replay mode. Speeds: 100, 143, 200, 300, 1000, 2000, 3000, 5000, 10000 ms.

tools.name: replay_stop
tools.description: Stop replay and return to realtime.

tools.name: replay_trade
tools.description: Execute a trade action in replay mode (buy, sell, or close position).

tools.name: replay_status
tools.description: Get current replay mode status.

tools.name: indicator_set_inputs
tools.description: Change indicator/study input values (length, source, period). Pass entity_id + JSON inputs string.

tools.name: indicator_toggle_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide an indicator/study on the chart.

tools.name: watchlist_get
tools.description: Get all symbols from the current TradingView watchlist with last price, change, and change%.

tools.name: watchlist_add
tools.description: Add a symbol to the TradingView watchlist.

tools.name: tab_list
tools.description: List all open TradingView chart tabs.

tools.name: tab_new
tools.description: Open a new chart tab.

tools.name: tab_close
tools.description: Close the current chart tab.

tools.name: tab_switch
tools.description: Switch to a chart tab by index (0-based, from tab_list).

tools.name: pane_list
tools.description: List all chart panes in the current layout with their symbols and active state.

tools.name: pane_set_layout
tools.description: Change the chart grid layout. Codes: s (single), 2h, 2v, 2-1, 1-2, 3h, 3v, 4 (2x2), 6, 8.

tools.name: pane_focus
tools.description: Focus a specific chart pane by index (0-based, from pane_list).

tools.name: pane_set_symbol
tools.description: Set the symbol on a specific pane by index.

tools.name: layout_list
tools.description: List saved chart layouts.

tools.name: layout_switch
tools.description: Switch to a saved chart layout by name or ID.

tools.name: ui_click
tools.description: Click a UI element by aria-label, data-name, text content, or class substring.

tools.name: ui_open_panel
tools.description: Open, close, or toggle TradingView panels: pine-editor, strategy-tester, watchlist, alerts, trading.

tools.name: ui_fullscreen
tools.description: Toggle TradingView fullscreen mode.

tools.name: ui_keyboard
tools.description: Press keyboard keys or shortcuts (e.g. Enter, Escape, Alt+S, Ctrl+Z).

tools.name: ui_type_text
tools.description: Type text into the currently focused input/textarea element.

tools.name: ui_hover
tools.description: Hover over a UI element by aria-label, data-name, text, or class substring.

tools.name: ui_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the chart or page in a direction (up/down/left/right).

tools.name: ui_mouse_click
tools.description: Click at specific x,y coordinates. Button left/right/middle, optional double_click.

tools.name: ui_find_element
tools.description: Find UI elements by text, aria-label, or CSS selector and return positions.

tools.name: ui_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in the TradingView page context for advanced automation. Wrap complex logic in an IIFE.
